name: Major floods
summary: Regional floods in Argentina and Haiti; no GDACS orange or red alerts
state: GDACS lists no orange or red flood alerts as of 1 Nov. Heavy rain in Odisha's Ganjam district triggered a landslide that left 12 people missing (ANI, 1 Nov), and Cyclone Murasu threatens further flooding in Andhra Pradesh around 3 Nov. El Niño-linked floods in Argentina have displaced about 2,600 people.
for_you: The strong El Niño raises flood risk in South America and East Africa over the coming months.

sources.title: ANI — Bay of Bengal depression intensifies; Ganjam landslide

why: Floods affect more people than any other hazard, displacing millions each year.
drivers: Extreme rainfall, monsoons, cyclones, snowmelt, dam failures.

rubric.alert: GDACS red flood alert, or > 100 deaths in a single event.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange flood alert, or a flood displacing > 50,000.
